biggest_catch: The referred friend must qualify for the $200 or $400 new-checking incentive within 75 days — the referral only pays if the friend completes the full direct-deposit and debit-transaction requirements. The new customer must not share a household with the referring member.
catches: The referring member must have a MIDFLORIDA checking account.
The prospective member must present the referral code or completed referral card at account opening.

The referred person must open a checking account (excluding Freedom Banking accounts) and qualify for the $200 or $400 checking incentive within 75 days — direct deposit of $2,000-$4,000, online banking, eStatement, debit card, and 20-40 debit-card purchases.
The new customer must not share a household with the referring member.
The referring member cannot refer their own account; secondary checking accounts do not qualify.
The referring member's account must be open and unrestricted when the incentive posts.
Offer valid as of September 1, 2026; may be canceled at any time without notice.
No referral cap is stated on the observed page.

c1.evidence: Verifiable program on institution's official domain: MIDFLORIDA Credit Union's official page 'Earn $100 for Referrals' (midflorida.com) describes the refer-a-friend offer.

c2.evidence: Concrete per-referral payout: the referring member earns $100 for each qualifying referral; the page title is 'Earn $100 for Referrals'.

c3.evidence: Mechanism: the referring member gives the prospective member a referral code or completed referral card, which must be presented at account opening.

c4.evidence: Timing: the incentive is posted to the referring member's account within 90 days.

eligibility: MIDFLORIDA Credit Union members with a checking account referring new members who do not share their household.
notes: MIDFLORIDA Credit Union (midflorida.com, Florida). Distinct from R0571 (Midflorida bank bonus) and R0599 (Florida Credit Union bank bonus). The $200/$400 amounts on the page are the friend's new-account checking incentives, not the referrer's reward.
numeric_basis: Per-referral payout of $100.00; no stated referral cap.
